waitForCurrentRun: Wait for the current run to finish.
completePendingReview: Complete the pending review or approval before retrying.
resolveBlockers: Resolve the task’s blockers before retrying.
taskChanged: The task changed. Refresh and try again.
repairStale: This repair no longer matches the task. Refresh to review its current state.
taskChangedWhileSaving: The task changed while saving. Refresh to check its current state.
